explanation: The function only checks that `username.length > 0`, so it accepts any non-empty string — including one made up entirely of spaces or tabs, like "   ". Because there's no `.trim()` (or equivalent) before the length check, whitespace-only input passes validation even though it isn't a meaningful username.
choices: It doesn't trim whitespace, so a string of only spaces incorrectly passes validation
It always returns false due to a logic error
It uses `length` instead of `size`, which doesn't exist on strings
It should use `===` instead of `>` for the comparison
